arguments.sql:
WITH lineups AS (
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           home_team_goal > away_team_goal AS won,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS players
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           away_team_goal > home_team_goal AS won,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS players
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
), slots AS (
    SELECT l.match_id, l.won, j.value AS player_api_id
    FROM lineups AS l
    CROSS JOIN json_each(l.players) AS j
), player_matches AS (
    SELECT match_id, player_api_id,
           COUNT(*) AS slot_count,
           COUNT(DISTINCT won) AS outcome_count
    FROM slots
    WHERE player_api_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY match_id, player_api_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."Match") AS matches,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."Match" WHERE home_team_goal = away_team_goal) AS draws,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."Match"
     WHERE home_team_goal IS NULL OR away_team_goal IS NULL) AS missing_scores,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(match_api_id) FROM main."Match") AS missing_match_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(match_api_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT match_api_id) FROM main."Match") AS duplicate_match_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(player_api_id) - COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) FROM main.Player) AS duplicate_player_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(player_name) - COUNT(DISTINCT player_name) FROM main.Player) AS repeated_player_names,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.match_view) AS view_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM main.match_view) AS view_distinct_matches,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM slots WHERE player_api_id IS NULL) AS null_slots,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_matches WHERE slot_count > outcome_count) AS repeated_same_side,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_matches WHERE outcome_count > 1) AS listed_on_both_sides,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player_matches AS a
     LEFT JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_api_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_player_matches

WITH team_lineups AS (
    SELECT match_api_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT match_api_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
), appearances AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.match_api_id, l.outcome, j.value AS player_api_id
    FROM team_lineups AS l
    CROSS JOIN json_each(l.lineup) AS j
    WHERE j.value IS NOT NULL
), conflicts AS (
    SELECT match_api_id, player_api_id
    FROM appearances
    GROUP BY match_api_id, player_api_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
), totals AS (
    SELECT a.outcome, a.player_api_id, COUNT(*) AS match_count,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(c.player_api_id) AS count_without_conflicts
    FROM appearances AS a
    LEFT JOIN conflicts AS c
      ON c.match_api_id = a.match_api_id AND c.player_api_id = a.player_api_id
    GROUP BY a.outcome, a.player_api_id
), comparisons AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS lineup_rank,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY count_without_conflicts DESC) AS conflict_free_rank
    FROM totals
)
SELECT c.outcome, p.player_name, c.match_count, c.count_without_conflicts,
       c.lineup_rank, c.conflict_free_rank
FROM comparisons AS c
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = c.player_api_id
WHERE c.lineup_rank <= 2 OR c.conflict_free_rank <= 2
ORDER BY c.outcome, c.lineup_rank, p.player_name

WITH team_lineups AS (
    SELECT match_api_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT match_api_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
), player_totals AS (
    SELECT l.outcome,
           j.value AS player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT l.match_api_id) AS match_count
    FROM team_lineups AS l
    CROSS JOIN json_each(l.lineup) AS j
    WHERE j.value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY l.outcome, j.value
), ranked AS (
    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, match_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank
    FROM player_totals
)
SELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.outcome_rank = 1
ORDER BY CASE r.outcome WHEN 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.player_name
LIMIT 1000
